text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day at dusk—
It all started with some casual small talk.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ze Aoharu Cup, is it?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aside from the Twinkle Series,
it was an inter-team competition held within Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
It's unofficial, and unlike official races it won't
affect an Umamusume's track record, but still.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
This is what gets me fired up! Clashing at times, overcoming
hardships together, and aiming purely for victory!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming hardships together... striving for victory...
To do that, with my friends—!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —Wonderfooool!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It sounds very, very fun, YES! And so,
I have come to ask the Chairwoman!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the "Aoharu Cup"!
What a nostalgic ring to it!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I hear that because it was once held concurrently with the Twinkle Series, withdrawals piled up and the tournament declined... But still!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The allure of team races and the blossoming of talent
they bring about have borne fruit in the Twinkle Series time and again!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Above all! Such a spirited drive to challenge a new wind
is admirable! Therefore—approved!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —At that dizzying pace, the next day arrived!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*clatter*)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "Mic check, mic check! —Pardon the interruption during lunch break. Attention all students and Trainers!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "Starting today, the Aoharu Cup is back!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Aoharu Hai"?
I wonder what that is, Rice-chan!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
I feel like I heard about this in class before...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "What is the Aoharu Cup?!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"An inter-team competition once held at Tracen Academy
to test each team's collective strength!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Sprint, Mile, Medium, Long, Dirt!
Competing across these 5 divisions to decide the top team!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"That said, this team
is not an official team that can run in the Twinkle Series!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Your top priority is to succeed
in the Twinkle Series!
I am well aware of this! —However!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Gain experiences impossible on your own!
Promote further growth as an Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Uniting as one with the gathered team members!
Polishing each other's skills! And celebrating our youth!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"In anticipation of your further growth!
I hereby declare the revival of the Aoharu Cup!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, Trainers, your first task
is to gather your team members!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "‘I expect great things from all of you! That is all!’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*click!*)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Let's training with friends!
Let's racing! is about to start!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the bombshell announcement,
shockwaves rippled throughout Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, giving her a new experience
doesn't sound like a bad idea.
choice_data_list: (Alright, I'm going to build a great team!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I was psyching myself up like that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*clatter*)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: “‘I completely forgot! A business trip to America spanning several years has just been finalized for me!’”

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "Because of that, going back and forth keeps me far too busy! I can't keep a proper eye on things!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, there is no need to worry!
Thanks to my earnest request—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I have requested a certain URA executive to serve as Acting Chairwoman!
Tracen Academy and the Aoharu Cup's management have been delegated!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: With her countless achievements as a Trainer and her heartfelt love for Umamusume, she will surely lead Tracen Academy to—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Um, Chairwoman, it's almost time...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Guh! Is it that time already?!
Well then, I shall take my leave—take off!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "I leave the rest to you! Do your best, everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vroooom...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The private helicopter took off with flair
and soared into the blue sky in no time at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, kicking off with tremendous momentum,
it's the "Aoharu Cup"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What was about to begin?
Unbeknownst to the giddy academy, dark clouds were rolling in...!
